name: setup-manaflow-ai-claude-code-whole
description: The Code tab’s project sidebar, transcript and prompt field, with the Claude demo’s New Tab, usage section and session status line.

files.themes/claude-code-app.json:
// The Claude desktop app's Code tab, dark: a neutral #191919 page, a warm #282524 sidebar with a 1 pt
// #3e3b3a line at its edge, the clay accent kept for marks only. Every color here is measured from a
// 2x capture of the real app (points, sRGB), not picked by eye.
{
  "name": "Claude Code app",
  "description": "A neutral #191919 page, a warm #282524 sidebar with a hairline edge, the clay accent for marks.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Dark",
  // The window, sidebar and pages take these colors, over an App Theme of your own.
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  // Page, chat prose ink, selected row card, clay.
  "colors": { "background": "#191919", "foreground": "#efefef", "selection": "#787474", "accent": "#d97757" },
  // The app keeps its chrome neutral: clay shows only on the logo and the working mark.
  "appearance.accent": "neutral",

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  // A flat window with the one line between the sidebar and the chat.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat-sidebar-line",
  "appearance.borders": "default",

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#1b1817",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#191919",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#191919",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#191919",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#3e3b3a",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#d97757",

  "appearance.density": "comfortable"
}
